extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media organizations, complainants and the German public interested in press ethics
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Deutscher Presserat's role and the high-level standards it promotes/implements for print and online journalism in Germany, plus navigation to resources (Pressekodex, complaints, decisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Einhaltung ethischer Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Er tritt für die Einhaltung ethischer Standards und Verantwortung im Journalismus ein.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage statement that the Deutscher Presserat advocates for compliance with ethical standards and journalistic responsibility; points users to the Press Code (Pressekodex) for the concrete rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verantwortung im Journalismus
rubrics_metrics.description: Verantwortung im Journalismus (responsibility in journalism) as a guiding principle for conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed as a core value alongside ethical standards; implies journalists and media should act responsibly toward subjects and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wahrung des Ansehens der Presse
rubrics_metrics.description: Wahrung des Ansehens der Presse (preservation of the reputation of the press).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Presserat sees itself as defending the standing and trustworthiness of the press; this functions as an evaluative aim when assessing complaints and decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selbstkontrolle der Print- und Onlinemedien
rubrics_metrics.description: Der Deutsche Presserat ist die Freiwillige Selbstkontrolle der Print- und Onlinemedien in Deutschland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The body is voluntary self-regulation for media, tasked with upholding standards and defending press freedom against external interference; this describes institutional scope and mandate rather than a single rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verteidigung der Pressefreiheit
rubrics_metrics.description: Als Selbstkontrolle verteidigt der Presserat die Pressefreiheit gegen Eingriffe von außen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protecting press freedom from external encroachment is an explicit priority and shapes how the council balances ethical enforcement with freedom of expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pressekodex (Press Code)
rubrics_metrics.description: Zum Pressekodex (link/entry point to the Press Code).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site directs users to the Pressekodex, the codified set of rules and concrete standards the Presserat uses to evaluate journalistic practice; the homepage itself does not reproduce the full code but points to it as the operative rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beschwerdeverfahren (Complaint procedure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Beschwerde einreichen — Information und Anleitung zu unserem Beschwerdeverfahren.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Presserat provides information and guidance on how to file complaints; availability and procedure of complaints is part of how standards are applied and enforced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entscheidungsdatenbank / Transparenz der Sanktionen
rubrics_metrics.description: Entscheidungen finden — Online-Archiv mit unseren Entscheidungen seit 1985.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A searchable archive of decisions (e.g., Rüge, Missbilligung, Hinweis) offers precedent and transparency about how the Presserat applies standards and sanctions; useful for evaluating similar cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redaktionsdatenschutz (Editorial data protection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Redaktionsdatenschutz — Die wichtigsten Antworten zum Datenschutz in Redaktionen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Site provides guidance on data protection issues relevant to editorial work, indicating this is an area of standards/expectations for journalistic practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finanzberichterstattung / Jahresberichte & Statistiken
rubrics_metrics.description: Finanzberichterstattung — Informationen zu Regelungen und Verfahren; Jahresberichte & Statistiken — Entwicklung von Beschwerden und Sanktionen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Presserat publishes financial reporting rules and annual reports/statistics, which function as accountability and performance metrics for the council and inform how enforcement activity evolves.
